# Contributing

Fork, branch, make the change, run this repo's own local checks (see its
README or `Makefile` for the exact commands), then open a pull request
against `main`. CI must be green before it merges; a red CI is never
merged. Keep the PR scoped to one change. See
`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` for what the description should contain.
